lines: Fresh loaves! Still warm from the oven!
Mind the flour, dear.
The honey buns go first. Always.
Coming through! Hot bread!
Mum says no samples.
Careful. The forge bites.
A blade mended by morning, if you like.
Good iron sings. Hear that?
Apples from the eastern orchards! Two for a copper!
Pears! Sweet as anything!
Caught this morning, up the river!
Trout! Fat river trout!
Silk from the southern road. Finest you will find.
That colour suits you, miss.
A posy for the pretty magician?
Roses! Daisies! Lavender!
Have you tried the honey buns?
Prices keep going up, you know.
Lovely day for it.
Market day is the best day.
Excuse me, dear.
I only came out for bread...
Keep out of trouble, traveller.
Quiet day. I like quiet days.
The gate closes at dusk.
Mind the chickens.
You can't catch me!
Do a card trick! Do a card trick!
Tag! You're it!
Are you a real magician?
Wait for me!
I saw a cat go into the alley...
♪ ...and the travellers walked on, long after the songs were done... ♪
A coin for the song? Or just a smile.
Winter comes. Always does.
Stand back a bit, eh?
Rooms are a silver a night. Stew included.
Wipe your feet if you come in!
Hm? This? A book of very small spells.
There is a spell for warming tea. It is my favourite.
In my day the fountain had fish in it.
The pigeons know me. Nobody else remembers.
Heavy, heavy...
Well water is the sweetest.
Flour for the baker. Every morning.
Harvest was good this year.

doors.label: Headmistress Aurel
doors.locked: Locked. A brass plate reads: HEADMISTRESS AUREL. KNOCK ONCE. I HEARD YOU ON THE STAIRS.

doors.label: Enchantments

signs.label: Look at the founder's candle
signs.text: ORLIND'S CANDLE. Lit in the sixtieth year of the Frost. It has not gone out. It burns a little lower when nobody is kind.

signs.label: Look at the globe
signs.text: The world, as it was understood forty years ago. Someone has pencilled in an island.

signs.label: Look at the armillary
signs.text: Brass rings, and a little sun that gives off real warmth.

signs.label: Look at the astrolabe
signs.text: It turns by itself. The pupils say it is keeping time for something, and nobody will say what.

signs.label: Read the plaque
signs.text: ORLIND THE SLOW. FOUNDER. "It took me nine years to light a candle. It has not gone out."

signs.label: Porter's lodge
signs.text: BRANDT, PORTER. Back in five minutes. The card has been there long enough to fade.

signs.label: Look at the target
signs.text: Scorched, soaked, frozen and, in one place, bitten.

signs.label: The observatory
signs.text: Barred until nightfall. Something inside hums, a little flat.

signs.label: Wim's bed
signs.text: Wim's bed is made so neatly you could cut bread on it.
